messages.count.title: Count messages
messages.count.description: Count mailbox messages via GET /v1.0/users/{userId}/messages/$count. Pass userId me for the signed-in user. Optional filter and search are OData $filter and $search. Sends ConsistencyLevel eventual, which Graph requires for $count. Maps to OUTLOOK_COUNT_MESSAGES. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/query-parameters?tabs=http

userId.description: User id or userPrincipalName. Pass me for the signed-in mailbox.

filter.description: OData $filter applied before counting. Omit the $filter= prefix. Do not combine with search.

search.description: KQL $search expression. Omit the $search= prefix. Do not combine with filter.

groups.get.title: Get group
groups.get.description: Get a Microsoft 365 group via GET /v1.0/groups/{groupId}. Maps to OUTLOOK_GET_GROUP. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/group-get?view=graph-rest-1.0

groups.threads.posts.attachments.get.title: Get group post attachment
groups.threads.posts.attachments.get.description: Get one attachment on a group conversation post via GET /v1.0/groups/{groupId}/threads/{threadId}/posts/{postId}/attachments/{attachmentId}. Maps to OUTLOOK_GET_GROUP_POST_ATTACHMENT. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/attachment-get?view=graph-rest-1.0

expand.description: OData $expand. For an item attachment use microsoft.graph.itemAttachment/item.

groups.conversations.list.title: List group conversations
groups.conversations.list.description: List conversation summaries in a Microsoft 365 group via GET /v1.0/groups/{groupId}/conversations. Maps to OUTLOOK_LIST_GROUP_CONVERSATIONS. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/group-list-conversations?view=graph-rest-1.0

filter.description: OData $filter for conversation properties Graph supports.

groups.threads.list.title: List group threads
groups.threads.list.description: List conversation threads in a Microsoft 365 group via GET /v1.0/groups/{groupId}/threads. Maps to OUTLOOK_LIST_GROUP_THREADS. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/group-list-threads?view=graph-rest-1.0

subscriptions.list.title: List notification subscriptions
subscriptions.list.description: List Microsoft Graph change-notification subscriptions visible to the caller via GET /v1.0/subscriptions. skipToken is the opaque $skiptoken from @odata.nextLink. Maps to OUTLOOK_LIST_NOTIFICATION_SUBSCRIPTIONS. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/subscription-list?view=graph-rest-1.0

skipToken.description: Opaque $skiptoken from the previous @odata.nextLink. Omit on the first page.

organization.list.title: List organizations
organization.list.description: List the connected Entra tenant organization via GET /v1.0/organization. User.Read returns id, displayName, and verifiedDomains; Organization.Read.All is required for other properties. Maps to OUTLOOK_LIST_ORGANIZATIONS. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/organization-list?view=graph-rest-1.0

messages.replyAll.title: Reply all
messages.replyAll.description: Reply to all recipients of a message via POST /v1.0/users/{userId}/messages/{messageId}/replyAll. Pass userId me for delegated access. Graph returns 202 with an empty body. Maps to OUTLOOK_REPLY_ALL. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/message-replyall?view=graph-rest-1.0

userId.description: Mailbox user id or userPrincipalName. Pass me for the signed-in user.

messageId.description: Microsoft Graph message id to reply to.

comment.description: Plain-text comment sent to reply-all recipients.

people.list.title: Search people
people.list.description: List people relevant to the signed-in user via GET /v1.0/me/people. search is sent as OData $search. skipToken is the opaque $skiptoken from @odata.nextLink. Sends ConsistencyLevel eventual, which Graph requires for people $search and $filter. Maps to OUTLOOK_SEARCH_PEOPLE. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/user-list-people?view=graph-rest-1.0

skip.description: Records to skip ($skip). Do not combine with search.

search.description: Fuzzy name or alias. Sent as OData $search.

skipToken.description: Opaque $skiptoken from the previous @odata.nextLink. Omit on the first page.

users.translateExchangeIds.title: Translate Exchange IDs
users.translateExchangeIds.description: Translate mailbox item ids between Exchange id formats via POST /v1.0/users/{userId}/translateExchangeIds. Pass userId me for the signed-in user. This POST does not modify mailbox data. Maps to OUTLOOK_TRANSLATE_EXCHANGE_IDS. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/user-translateexchangeids?view=graph-rest-1.0

userId.description: User id or userPrincipalName. Pass me for the signed-in mailbox.

inputIds.description: Exchange identifiers to translate. Every id uses sourceIdType and the same mailbox.

sourceIdType.description: Format of every identifier in inputIds.

targetIdType.description: Format to translate the identifiers into.
